summary: Share link (all scenario state in the URL) is unchanged and covered by url-state tests. New this round: CSV export of the 10-minute stay series (through the Web Worker, reusing the site series cache) and JSON export of scenario, metrics, dataset names, grade, engine commit and the two shape-B Horizons queries that reproduce the Sun and Earth directions for the stay window.
jsonPayloadFields: result (verdict, decidingRule, grade, terrain, metrics, slip)
horizonsCheck (only when a cached query exists for the site)
csvPath: SiteSeriesCache -> exportSeriesCsv (app/src/scenario.ts) -> engine.worker export-series request/response -> browser download
note: Interactive click-through was not performed in this headless environment; the code path is type-checked, unit-tested for the CSV builder, and mirrors the existing matrix request/response pattern. The browser download uses Blob URLs.
